slides.stem: Group A has $8$ members with a mean score of $72$. Group B has $12$ members with a mean score of $83$. What is the mean score of the combined group?

slides.intro: Go back to totals: points over people.
slides.trapWhy: $77.5$ is the simple average of $72$ and $83$. It ignores that Group B is bigger.

slides.title: Combined means are weighted
slides.body:
To merge groups, go back to totals: total points over total people. The bigger group drags the mean toward its own.

If the combined mean you computed sits exactly halfway between the two group means, that's your cue you averaged the averages.
